resolutions.researcher_notes: Egyptian Cabinet press release (2023 annual production report) states Phase 1 of the North Geisum Shemali GNN field development 'ينتج المشروع 12 ألف برميل زيت خام يومياً ... وانشاء خط بقطر 10 بوصة وطول 5.3 كم' -- 12,000 bpd of crude oil moved via a new 10in/5.3km line. Supports Fuel=Oil. Single official source (the seed url_verifier target petroleumfuture.net is a dead domain with no Wayback capture) -> medium.

The only usable source (cabinet.gov.eg) describes a short 5.3km/10in line tying 3 new wells into production facilities -- it never characterizes the line as 'transmission' and its scale/context (well-to-facility tie-in) reads more like a gathering line, which would conflict with the sheet's 'transmission' value. petroleumfuture.net (original current_ref) is a dead domain (DNS does not resolve) with no Wayback snapshot available, so it cannot be checked either. Left UNRESOLVED per rule 7 rather than citing a source that does not actually confirm 'transmission'.

Same Cabinet release: 'وتم بدء الإنتاج في مارس 2023' -- production/operations began March 2023 as part of the government's completed-2023-field-developments list, supporting Status=operating. Single official source -> medium.
Same Cabinet release states production began 'مارس 2023' -- exact match for StartYear1=2023. Single official source -> medium.

current_ref (cabinet.gov.eg) is in fact LIVE (200), not dead -- the pre-sweep DEAD_LINK flag was a false negative. It reads 'ينتج المشروع 12 ألف برميل زيت خام يومياً' -- exact match for Capacity=12,000 bpd. Single official source -> medium.
Same cabinet.gov.eg page (confirmed live, not dead) states 'وذلك بتكلفة استثمارية حوالى 23 مليون دولار' -- exact match for Cost=23,000,000 USD. Single official source -> medium.
